methods.replicates: Five matched training seeds (1-5); summaries use arithmetic mean and sample SD (ddof=1).
methods.paired_differences: E-D isolates learned gate within shared+prior models; C-A compares shared versus independent without physics. Differences are left minus right by matched seed.
methods.uncertainty: 95% t intervals use df=4 and t*=2.7764. They are descriptive because there are only five training seeds; no p-values are reported.

rock_target_range_anomaly.note: The rock test target range extends substantially beyond the training target maximum; high-end prediction is extrapolation.

evidence_notes: The classical logistic_regression baseline outperforms every neural configuration on slope accuracy (0.842697 versus best neural mean 0.725843, E_shared_prior_gate).
The classical logistic_regression baseline outperforms every neural configuration on slope balanced_accuracy (0.835913 versus best neural mean 0.695046, E_shared_prior_gate).
The classical logistic_regression baseline outperforms every neural configuration on slope f1 (0.865385 versus best neural mean 0.793077, E_shared_prior_gate).
The classical logistic_regression baseline outperforms every neural configuration on slope roc_auc (0.915377 versus best neural mean 0.877709, D_shared_prior).
The classical ridge_alpha_1 baseline outperforms every neural configuration on rock rmse (53.7843 versus best neural mean 53.9788, B_independent_prior).
The classical ridge_alpha_1 baseline outperforms every neural configuration on rock r2 (0.444373 versus best neural mean 0.438377, B_independent_prior).
B_independent_prior settlement is seed-sensitive: seed 2 has MAE 2.29566 and RMSE 3.07608, while the other four seeds have MAE 0.742263-0.845137 and RMSE 1.04355-1.15305.
E_shared_prior_gate slope ROC-AUC is visibly bimodal across these five runs (0.687822, 0.893189, 0.869453, 0.862745, 0.695046), so its mean has substantial seed uncertainty.
The rock test maximum UCS is 560.31 MPa versus 318.2 MPa in training; evaluation at the upper end therefore measures extrapolation.
Analytical-prior metrics use only prior-valid cases (slope 71/89, rock 267/608, settlement 75/75) and must not be compared as if they used the full test denominators.
